notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
- Made the Ability Selection Wheel nicer to use.
- Fixed a bug with player death involving the accuracy of respawning.
- Changed a respawn position in Base Camp.
- Changed a respawn position in Frozen Ruins.

notes.title: LAN Removed
notes.content:
There has been issues with the current implementation of LAN, so it has been removed.
I'm very sorry for anyone who purchased the game for the LAN feature.
Please feel free to refund the game if you have.

- Rombo
